family: Quadratic bent seed b(x)=(-1)^(x0*x1+x2*x3) on four data bits, with arbitrary flip subset D of cardinality 1,2,3,4; selector chooses b or b(1-2*1_D); r fresh controls activate at z=0, constant +1 otherwise.
symmetry: None: every subset in the domain is enumerated; repeated ledger computations may be memoized by full actual ordered truth table.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh sums, edge/face counts, rational influence and credit. B-4d reduced to integer linear combination of log2 primes; outward 80-bit fixed-denominator intervals derived from 50-term rational atanh series. All-zero prime expression gives exact equality; any unresolved sign uses exact integer products, never float.
memory_control: Bounded LRU caches, n<=9, no automatic dimension changes. No job expected over 300 MB.
maximizer_scope: Exact max over declared subsets/cardinalities/r and four fixed orders; also max of min over four orders. No universal or all-adaptive-tree optimum asserted.
